name: OpenShellBackend

test_list.description: Register canonical policy content under its BLAKE3 CID, resolve exact bytes, and reject unknown CIDs.
Encode CPU millicores and memory MiB as the pinned OpenShell gateway limits Struct consumed by Docker's enforced quotas.
Reject oversized execution inputs and output limits before unbounded transport handling.
Reject oversized path entries before adding them to a bounded list.
Accept valid immutable page metadata and reject oversized, mismatched, or out-of-order continuation responses.
Reject traversal paths, escaping symbolic links, and link target hashes that do not match.
Reject oversized conditional-commit payloads before guest execution.
Retry only transient connection errors until the overall deadline and return permanent failures immediately.
Verify dropping the retry future drops an in-flight connection attempt without detached work.
Retry refused/not-connected sockets while rejecting certificate-like I/O errors.
Map gRPC AlreadyExists to a typed result so cleanup cannot delete an unrelated existing sandbox.
Accept only completed/already-absent acknowledgements or accepted deletes bound to the original sandbox ID.
Reject gateway driver metadata that does not match the requested Docker or VM backend.
Reject names exceeding the upstream OpenShell limit before making an RPC.
Reject mutable image tags and accept only immutable SHA-256 image references.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Gateway endpoint, mTLS material, version gate and operation bounds.

inputs.name: spec
inputs.description: Sandbox request with a required policy CID.

output_description: A ready sandbox created with the exact CID-verified policy, or a typed failure.
